dimension_basis: Engineering candidate dimensions, not a supplier inventory. Existing structural cavity depths remain fixed; homogeneous insulation varies at most 50 mm from its documented source depth. Loose-fill depths are settled model dimensions. Multilayer sums must respect total intervention caps.
selection: Evidence family and compatibility first; feasible within 2% before source-depth departure, then U error and deterministic dimension ordering. If infeasible, U error precedes source departure.

technical_sources.finding: Warm roof coverings require a suitable rigid insulation substrate. TF is an upper-layer board; low-density batts do not establish compressive capacity. No new product properties adopted.
Open-attic loose-fill installation requires preparation and installation inspection. Product-specific settlement cannot be transferred to the retained stone-wool family.

family_selection: Retain period-stack families unless original-condition extraction supports a compatible alternative. Unknown-condition observations provide context only. No stock-frequency weighting or mixing material conductivity across records.
